title: Billing and Coding: Hyaluronans Intra-articular Injections of

codes.1: Effective for dates of service on or after 04/01/2021, HCPCS code J7321 should be used to report Visco-3™. Report HCPCS code C9465 for Durolane® when billed to the Part A MAC and HCPCS code J3490 when billed to the Part B MAC for dates of service prior to 01/01/2019. For dates of service on or after 10/01/2019 HCPCS code J7331 should be used to report Synojoynt™. For dates of service on or after 10/01/2019 HCPCS code J7332 should be used to report Triluron™.
